subject: mathematics
content: Consider the matrices $A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 \\ 4 & -2 \end{bmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 9 \\ 1 & 3 \end{bmatrix}$. If matrices $P$ and $Q$ are such that $PA = B$ and $AQ = B$, then the absolute value of the sum of the diagonal elements of $2(P + Q)$ is ________.
